## Appearance

Charlotta has a freckled face featuring a snubbed nose and a wide mouth that offers wide smiles. Her hair, which she previously wore braided in innumerable plaits, is styled in an enormous pompadour.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.People P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted handmaiden who shows genuine concern for the well-being of her beloved mistress.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

## History

Charlotta the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) worked as a young helper and maid for Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where she assisted with household duties, picked strawberries, and expressed deep concern when her employer was feeling unusually despondent. Following the resolution of Miss Lavendar's romance, Charlotta excitedly prepared for a move to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) and helped tidy [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) after Miss Lavendar's garden wedding. Years later, she returned to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as one of the guests attending Anne's wedding, and she eventually married a good-tempered [American](../codex/factions.md#american) bricklayer named Tom.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), +23 more_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta serves as the young helper and handmaiden to Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where she assists with domestic duties such as setting up tea and demonstrating the home's unique echoing horn. Charlotta takes active care of her mistress's well-being, confiding her concern to visitors when Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) appears unusually despondent or apathetic. She also helps prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for Miss Lavendar's wedding and tidies up the house alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after the ceremony.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +17 more_

- Serves under — mistress to handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), +1 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlotta.md)

Charlotta first met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and stayed for tea. The two grew friendly over subsequent visits, picking early strawberries together and coordinating to cheer up Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) during her periods of gloom. By Volume 4, they are established as old friends who previously worked together to prepare and clean up after Miss Lavendar's wedding.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009)_

- Friend of — old friends who attended a wedding together long ago (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009)</sub>
